blurb: Near-black surfaces, a grotesk and mono pairing, hairline grids and one amber signal.

direction.name: Dark Instrument
direction.thesis: A precise technical instrument: dark surfaces, hairline grids and monospace labels, with one amber signal colour reserved for the thing you should act on.
direction.grid: Strict 12-column grid drawn with visible 1px lines; panels align to the grid and share edges instead of floating with gaps.
direction.hero: Headline and action on the left; on the right a drawn instrument panel (graticule, rings, ticks) that expresses the product's mechanism. Corner brackets frame the panel.
direction.imagery: Diagrams, graticules and real product output, drawn in line work with the line and accent tokens. No stock photos, no 3D blobs.
direction.motion: A single slow sweep on the instrument panel; hover states change border colour only. Reduced motion freezes the sweep.
direction.voice: Terse and exact. Verbs and units. Labels in monospace, sentences in sans.
direction.signature: The amber sweep line crossing the instrument panel.
